newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber ends mostly down on yen's rebound.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber ends mostly down on yen's rebound.

text.p: Most Tokyo rubber futures ended lower on Wednesday as long-liquidation gathered force towards the end of the day due to the yen's rebound against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from 4.0 yen per kg lower to 0.2 yen up.
Benchmark October closed 3.2 yen weaker at 132.0 yen.

The market started the day moderately firmer on technical buying after sharp declines on Tuesday, but selling accelerated as the yen rose. "A growing view that the yen has more room to rise, dampened market sentiment," one trader said.
